bug_location: merge_intervals: the condition `s < out[-1][1]` on the overlap check line
explanation: There are two bugs: (1) the intervals are not sorted before processing, so overlapping intervals given out of order won't be merged correctly; (2) the condition `s < out[-1][1]` should be `s <= out[-1][1]` to handle touching intervals (where next.start == current.end). The fix adds `sorted(...)` and changes `<` to `<=`.
